answer_4.quote: We recruit human annotators to evaluate the performance. Scores range from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: If two models are considered to be equally good or bad, they will have the same score. For each data, the annotator will assign a score for each model. We only allow at most 2 models that are equally good or bad, and for each annotator, the total number of ties should be no more than 10 for the whole set.
